claim_being_audited: The Actor claims the current release can be certified because aggregate readiness passes and there were no severity-one rehearsal incidents, provided the pharmacy prior authorization weakness is explicitly disclosed in the release documentation.
decision_criteria: Aggregate readiness above threshold and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support release readiness but are not alone sufficient for certification under the policy.
A named launch use-case weakness below threshold is material unless shown otherwise in the admissible record.

Policy requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and requires material segment weaknesses to be disclosed or covered by approved mitigation before certification may proceed.
Contextual guidance from public governance sources supports documentation and monitoring expectations but does not satisfy the internal policy predicate by itself.
The verdict changes to compliant if admissible evidence shows the current documentation already includes the pharmacy limitation or an approved mitigation/risk acceptance covers it.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release documentation or model card text showing the pharmacy prior authorization limitation is explicitly disclosed.
Provide an approved mitigation or signed risk-acceptance record covering the pharmacy prior authorization weakness before launch.
Provide the current certification packet section demonstrating that present evaluation results, including the subgroup regression, are reflected in the release materials.
specific_concerns: The policy threshold is not met on the current record because the material pharmacy weakness is not shown as disclosed in current release documentation and is not covered by approved mitigation or risk acceptance.
The informal monitoring comment is not a reviewed mitigation, approved acceptance, or attached disclosure artifact.
Prior approval of the same model family is stale after the retrieval configuration change and current eval batch, so it cannot carry the current certification decision.
The Actor's position depends on future or conditional documentation rather than documentation already present in the admissible record.
unsupported_claims: That certification is currently compliant on the existing record.
That explicit disclosure of the pharmacy limitation is already present in the release documentation.
That informal monitoring after launch is sufficient to satisfy the approved-mitigation or risk-acceptance requirement.
